extra_messages.content: You died just 12 steps after this checkpoint, so whatever you did next was fatal. Take a different route entirely—avoid the area or enemy that killed you and focus on mining deeper for diamonds or gold to unlock the remaining achievements.
Explore a completely different direction from last time to avoid whatever killed you. Prioritize finding new biomes and resources over combat, and retreat from any fight you're not confident in.

You have iron gear and 16 achievements—seek diamonds or gold by exploring deeper underground or new biomes. Avoid the area where you previously died; take a completely different route and prioritize mining over combat.

You have full iron gear and 15 achievements—head in a completely new direction to find diamonds, gold, or new biomes while avoiding the area where you keep dying. Keep your distance from zombies and retreat if health drops below half.

You have full iron gear and 15 achievements at step 163—head in a completely new direction to find diamonds, gold, or a new biome. Avoid the area to the south/east where you keep dying around step 180-200; explore north or west instead and dig deeper underground for diamond ore.
You have full iron gear and 17 achievements—now seek diamonds by mining deeper underground toward bedrock level. Watch for lava and avoid surface combat at night.

You have 229 steps left and full iron gear—dig a staircase tunnel downward toward bedrock level to find diamonds, but never dig straight down and wall off any lava you encounter. If you can't find diamonds quickly, pivot to hunting cows or skeletons for remaining achievements.

Before diving underground, craft iron armor from your iron supply—previous attempts keep dying in mines. Once armored, dig a careful staircase down to diamond level, placing torches and walling off lava as you go.

Craft full iron armor before going underground—every mining attempt has died. If you lack iron, gather more from surface deposits first, then dig a careful staircase to diamond level, walling off tunnels behind you.
